create.name: Tushita Meditation Centre
create.bio:
Tushita Meditation Centre is a Tibetan Buddhist study and retreat centre on a wooded hillside near Dharamkot, above McLeod Ganj in Himachal Pradesh, where the Dalai Lama lives in exile. Lama Thubten Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche bought an old colonial house there in 1972, first as a retreat place for Western students coming from their courses at Kopan in Nepal. It belongs to the FPMT network and teaches in the Gelug tradition of Lama Tsongkhapa.

Tushita is best known for its ten-day residential Introduction to Buddhism courses, held in silence and mixing philosophy classes with guided meditation on the mind, karma, compassion and the nature of reality. It also runs shorter weekend courses, intermediate teachings and group retreats with visiting geshes and rinpoches, a pre-ordination course, and daily drop-in guided meditations open in person and on Zoom. Since 2020 it has offered online programmes too. Its YouTube channel, started in 2011, keeps recordings of these teachings, from multi-day courses to single talks and ceremonies.

courses.title: Introduction to Buddhism (10-day residential course)
courses.description: A ten-day silent residential course led by Venerable Tenzin Thegchog, combining classes on Buddhist philosophy with guided meditation; open to newcomers and returning students.

courses.title: A Boundless Mind – The Four Immeasurable Thoughts
courses.description: A two-day non-residential course with Venerable Thubten Wangdu on cultivating loving-kindness, compassion, sympathetic joy and equanimity in daily life.

courses.title: Personal retreat
courses.description: Individual retreats of ten days or more for experienced practitioners who bring their own teacher's instructions and keep a set daily practice schedule.

free_resources.title: Daily drop-in guided meditations
free_resources.description: Free hour-long guided meditations from Monday to Saturday at 9am Indian time, held in the centre and on Zoom, with recordings on YouTube; donations welcome.

free_resources.title: Video and audio recordings
free_resources.description: Tushita's page of recorded teachings from its courses and retreats, linking to its YouTube channel and audio archive.
